description: Ingest new content from a file into the vault, tracking progress with a cursor so only new lines are ingested on each call. Safe to call repeatedly — only the delta since the last call is stored.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the file to ingest

session_id.description: Cursor key — defaults to the file path. Use a stable ID (e.g. session ID) to track the same file across calls

name: vmn_ingest_file
